title: Naturality of the fixed left-factor projection
statement: For any commutative condensed ring Λ, morphism g : X → S of schemes, morphism k : K → K′ in the unbounded derived category of internal Λ_S-module objects, and object N in the analogous category on X, the fixed left-factor projection map of [def-sfb-projective-diagonal-composition] satisfies (k ⊗ id) ≫ projectionMap(g,K′,N) = projectionMap(g,K,N) ≫ Rg_*(Lg^*(k) ⊗ id). No properness or invertibility is assumed.

source.place: clause (3), each constituent is a natural transformation

proof.text: The native traceProjection is the right-factor projection mate conjugated by the source and target braidings. Use braiding naturality in the left variable on S, the right projection mate naturality in its S argument, and braiding naturality in the right variable on X. Compose the three commuting squares and combine the direct-image maps by functoriality. Abstract the normalized projection family before unfolding the shared tensor bundle; its heterogeneous normalization becomes ordinary equality and transfers the native square to projectionMap.

proof_origin.place: C1 formalization of constituent naturality in clause (3)

lean.statement:
theorem projectionMap_naturality {X S : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ S)
    {K K' : DerivedCategory (Modules Λ S)} (k : K ⟶ K')
    (N : DerivedCategory (Modules Λ X)) :
    tensorHom k (𝟙 _) ≫ projectionMap Λ g K' N =
      projectionMap Λ g K N ≫
        (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward Λ g).map
          (tensorHom ((moduleObjectDerivedPullback Λ g).map k) (𝟙 N))
